title: 07 · Tablet on the ward: Vigil
strengths: The dashboard inside is the strength: a NEWS2 ward view with 'Rosa Halvorsen · Bed 7', 'Allergy: penicillin', vitals with usual ranges and traces, a 12-hour score strip; it is specific and reads as a real clinical tool
The photo is real and calm (white table, a glass of water half out of frame, window light), and the slight rotation keeps the plate from being a template
slop_signals: The window-light shadows cross the table at the top right but never cross the tablet or its screen, and the screen shows no glare or reflection: the device is pasted onto the photo rather than lit by it
The tablet's own cast shadow is a faint even halo instead of a shadow thrown toward the lower left, so it floats a few millimetres above the table
A uniform thin black bezel with a silver rim and that corner radius is an iPad Pro outline; the notes call it generic
fixes: Paint the same diagonal window shadow across the bezel and the screen as a multiply band at 10 to 15%, continuous with the table's shadow
Replace the halo with a soft shadow offset 12 to 20 px toward the lower left, darker at the contact edge
Add a 3 to 5% white diagonal reflection on the glass and darken the screen 5% toward the edges
Make the frame nobody's: a slightly thicker chin, a matte dark rim instead of silver, or a different corner radius

references.what: A tablet composited onto a photographed wood desk, rotated, with a cast shadow that matches the scene; the closest shipped example of our plate
A health dashboard in a generic tablet frame on black; frontal and flat, nothing else on the plate
Flat tablet frames on blobs: the template look a photo was meant to avoid
Product UI shown on a plain card with no device at all; an honest alternative when the hardware cannot be lit

owner.said: Hide until it is re-rendered with the rebuilt screens
